name: Benchmark ROV Model
description: A standard remotely operated vehicle (ROV) model provided to evaluate/benchmark identification and control algorithms for ROVs.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate and control/tracking error (e.g., RMSE of position/heading) with stability/robustness metrics
reputation: A standard academic ROV model used in marine robotics research for algorithm development and comparative studies, but not a universal community benchmark.
notes: Often used in simulation (transfer to hardware may be nontrivial); benchmark evaluates control/identification (non-LLM); results depend strongly on modeling fidelity and environmental assumptions (e.g., current, disturbances).
